{{nihongo|'''Kawashima Shrine'''|川島神社 (江南市)}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Kōnan, Aichi|Q820496|qid=Q820496}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|Q80434|qid=Q80434}}. It is one candidate shrine for "Kawashima Shrine" in Haguri District of {{ill|Owari Province|ar|أواري|ca|Província d'Owari|ckb|پارێزگای ئۆوواری|cs|Provincie Owari|de|Provinz Owari|es|Provincia de Owari|eu|Owari probintzia|fa|ولایت اوواری|fi|Owarin provinssi|fr|Province d'Owari|gl|Provincia de Owari|hak|Owari-koet|id|Provinsi Owari|it|Owari (provincia)|ja|尾張国|ko|오와리국|lt|Ovario žemė|nl|Owari (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Owari|pt|Província de Owari|ru|Овари (провинция)|simple|Owari Province|sk|Owari (provincia)|sr|Провинција Овари|tr|Owari (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Оварі|vi|Tỉnh Owari|wuu|尾张国|zh|尾張國|zh_min_nan|Owari-kok|zh_yue|尾張國|qid=Q514506}} in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}', though there are many differing theories. {{nihongo|'''Kawashima Shrine'''|川島神社 (江南市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

== History ==
Its founding time is unknown. Until the {{ill|Edo period|lt=Edo period|qid=Q184963}}, it was called '''Gozu Tennō''', and is said to have declined due to repeated floods. The site was formerly called "Tenjinmori." In the mid-Edo period, a theory emerged identifying it as the Haguri District "Kawashima Shrine" in the Engishiki register, and it was rebuilt. In {{ill|1898|ab|1898|af|1898|als|1898|am|1898 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1898|ar|1898|ary|1898|arz|1898|ast|1898|av|1898|avk|1898|az|1898|azb|۱۸۹۸ (میلادی)|ba|1898 йыл|ban|1898|bar|1898|bat_smg|1898|bcl|1898|be|1898|be_x_old|1898|bg|1898|bn|১৮৯৮|bpy|মারি ১৮৯৮|br|1898|bs|1898.|ca|1898|cdo|1898 nièng|ce|1898 шо|ceb|1898|ckb|١٨٩٨|crh|1898|cs|1898|csb|1898|cv|1898|cy|1898|da|1898|de|1898|diq|1898|el|1898|eml|1898|eo|1898|es|1898|et|1898|eu|1898|fa|۱۸۹۸|fi|1898|fiu_vro|1898|fo|1898|fr|1898|frp|1898|frr|1898|fur|1898|fy|1898|ga|1898|gan|1898年|gcr|1898|gd|1898|gl|1898|gn|1898|gv|1898|he|1898|hi|१८९८|hif|1898|hr|1898.|hsb|1898|ht|1898 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1898|hy|1898|hyw|1898 թուական|ia|1898|id|1898|ilo|1898|inh|1898 шу|io|1898|is|1898|it|1898|ja|1898年|jv|1898|ka|1898|kaa|1898|kk|1898 жыл|kn|೧೮೯೮|ko|1898년|krc|1898 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1898|ku|1898|kv|1898-ӧд во|la|1898|lb|1898|lez|1898 йис|li|1898|lij|1898|lmo|1898|lt|1898 m.|lv|1898. gads|mai|१८९८|map_bms|1898|mdf|1898|mg|1898|mhr|1898|mi|1898|min|1898|mk|1898|ml|1898|mn|1898 он|mr|इ.स. १८९८|mrj|1898 и|ms|1898|my|၁၈၉၈|myv|1898 ие|mzn|۱۸۹۸|nah|1898|nap|1898|nds|1898|new|ई सं १८९८|nl|1898|nn|1898|no|1898|nov|1898|nrm|1898|nso|1898|oc|1898|olo|1898|or|୧୮୯୮|os|1898-æм аз|pa|1898|pap|1898|pl|1898|pnb|1898|pt|1898|qu|1898|ro|1898|ru|1898 год|rue|1898|sa|१८९८|sah|1898 сыл|sc|1898|scn|1898|sco|1898|sd|1898ع|se|1898|sh|1898.|shn|1898|si|1898|simple|1898|sk|1898|sl|1898|smn|1898|sq|1898|sr|1898|stq|1898|su|1898|sv|1898|sw|1898|szl|1898|ta|1898|te|1898|tg|Соли 1898|th|พ.ศ. 2441|tk|1898|tl|1898|tly|1898|tr|1898|tt|1898 ел|udm|1898 ар|ug|1898 - يىلى|uk|1898|ur|1898ء|uz|1898|vec|1898|vi|1898|vls|1898|vo|1898|wa|1898|war|1898|xmf|1898|yi|1898|za|1898 nienz|zea|1898|zh|1898年|zh_classical|一八九八年|zh_min_nan|1898 nî|zh_yue|1898年|qid=Q7848}} ({{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 31), it was officially renamed "Kawashima Shrine."

However, the Shikinaisha "Kawashima Shrine" has multiple candidate shrines and is not settled in scholarship. This is said to be because the nearby {{ill|Kiso River|Q779607|qid=Q779607}} repeatedly flooded and washed away shrine buildings, making exact identification unclear. Candidate shrines include:

* Kawashima Shrine: Miyata-chō, Konan, Aichi
* {{ill|Shirahige Shrine (Kakamigahara)|Q124668655|qid=Q124668655|lt=Shirahige Shrine}}: {{ill|Kawashima Kasada-chō|Q131938355|qid=Q131938355}}, {{ill|Kakamigahara|Q641491|qid=Q641491}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}
* {{ill|Enoki Shrine|Q134893091|qid=Q134893091|lt=Enoki Shrine}}: {{ill|Kawashima Matsukura-machi|Q131870131|qid=Q131870131}}, Kakamigahara, Gifu
* Kawashima Tenjin Shrine (precinct shrine of {{ill|Waguri Shrine|Q11616546|qid=Q11616546}}): Shimamura, {{ill|Ichinomiya, Aichi|Q270810|qid=Q270810}}, Aichi
* {{ill|Kaminoshima-Shinmei Shrine|Q11358370|qid=Q11358370}}: Kawashima Matsukura-chō, Kakamigahara, Gifu
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shamiya Shrine}}: {{ill|Narukiyo-chō|Q131983825|qid=Q131983825}}, Kakamigahara, Gifu
* {{ill|Shirahige Shrine|Q134987078|qid=Q134987078|lt=Shirahige Shrine}}: {{ill|Matsumoto-chō|Q131870034|qid=Q131870034|lt=Matsumoto-chō}}, Kakamigahara, Gifu
* {{ill|Yatsurugi Shrine (Ginan)|Q11390592|qid=Q11390592|lt=Yatsurugi Shrine}}: Miyamachi, {{ill|Ginan, Gifu|Q1204285|qid=Q1204285}}, {{ill|Hashima District, Gifu|Q615068|qid=Q615068}}, Gifu

According to surviving passages of the '{{ill|Owari no Kuni Fudoki|Q135598023|qid=Q135598023}}', the Shikinaisha "Kawashima Shrine" was in Kawashima Village, Kawanuma-gō, Haguri District, and was a shrine built by imperial order after a {{ill|white deer|Q72616124|qid=Q72616124}} appeared from time to time in the reign of {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|Q349263|qid=Q349263}}.
